kjv: an high priest of good things to come
mine: a high priest of the good things that have come
note: TR "mellonton" (to come) against "genomenon" (that have come; P46, B, D*); the early text treats the blessings as already realised.

kjv: now once in the end of the world hath he (Christ) appeared
mine: he (Christ) has appeared once for all at the end of the ages
note: epi synteleia ton aionon is "at the culmination of the ages"; "end of the world" (as in Matthew) suggests the world's end, not the turning point of history.
